findings.title: [P2] Reject targeted automatic speech when no chat target is active
findings.body:
chat-lifetime-and-native-playback:

The target guard only rejects mismatches when `_target` is non-null. `SuspendSurface` and `ClearRemovedSession` explicitly clear the target, but a subsequently delivered response passed through `SpeakResponseAsync(text, sessionKey)` then bypasses this guard and starts fresh synthesis and playback. Canceling the previously active operation does not prevent this late response from speaking after suspension or session removal. Require an active matching target for session-scoped automatic responses, while preserving manual preview behavior, and cover the cleared-target case in the regression tests.

report.overall_explanation: No actionable defects were identified in the supplied assigned changes. Admission uses handshake-granted scopes, advertised methods, and the current connection epoch; speech responses are correlated, errors sanitized, and audio bounded without retry or local fallback. The persisted opt-in defaults to false. The inline response shape matches the [upstream handler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/src/gateway/server-methods/tts.ts). However, required caller/owner integration evidence was not supplied: settings persistence wiring, speech callers, retirement, and serialized native playback ownership cannot be verified. Tests also inject readiness rather than exercise issued handshake authority. The assessment therefore remains incomplete; the existing CI cancellation failure remains unclassified.
